description: Each week, holds every one of the ten large coins whose 4-week return is positive, equally weighted, and cash for the rest. Falsified if the filter fails to step aside in crypto bear markets. Backtested on FinzData crypto daily closes (7-day weeks, weekends included), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: Crypto time-series momentum · 4-week · 10 large coins
